notes.title: Version 1.3 - The VR Update!
notes.content:
We are excited to release our Version 1.3 Update! This update adds in festive holiday art sets and also is our initial (beta) release for Eyes of the Night in VR. As of now, this build only supports Oculus headsets, but we hope to expand our VR compatibility in the future. 

Here are the full patch notes for version 1.3: 

[u][b]Additions:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Beta - VR Support for Oculus Headsets (Rift S and Quest 2 with Oculus Link)
[list]
[*] This is a beta implementation of VR support. We will continue to refine and we hope to expand support to additional VR hardware. We would love your feedback and/or suggestions on our Discord server or in the Discussion page. 
[*] Possible Known Issue: We have seen some reports of VR not initializing properly and are investigating. We found possible work-arounds with restarting the Oculus software or restarting the computer and we are actively working to identify if we can implement a permanent solution.
[/list]
[*] Christmas themed art set - Elves and presents and candy canes...all the festive stuff!
[*] Three new “winter wonderland” art sets, exclusive (for now) to the Christmas art sets
[/list]




[u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with enemies sometimes getting stuck on fences in stealth mode
[*] Fixed issue with trees not spawning along axis lines (creating a + type pattern)
[*] Fixed issue with stealth mode not always recognizing when you are in a bush
[*] Fixed issue with llamas spitting on the windshields of passing cars
[*] Fixed issue with enemies sometimes pushing player out of bounds
[*] Fixed issue with bush LOD scaling
[*] Fixed issue with potion light brightness
[*] Moved coffee cups away from the edges of tables so cats wouldn’t knock them off
[*] Fixed rare issue with stealth mode not always applying proper health drain when sprinting
[*] Fixed rare issue with potion respawn
[*] Fixed very rare issue that could get player stuck at main menu scene without menu options
[/list]


[b][u]Improvements:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Rewrote input system (step one to provide full controller support in future update)
[*] Improved 3D sound system
[/list]

notes.title: Eyes of the Night Virtual Reality Update
notes.content:
Our free version 1.3 content update will be releasing soon and we are excited to announce that in addition to the already planned holiday content, we will also be adding support for Oculus virtual reality systems! 

While our roadmap initially planned the version 1.3 update to release on December 8, we are having to postpone the 1.3 update for a week (now planned to release on December 15) as we finish up testing and tweaking on the VR update. 

As we have tested (extensively) internally, we are really excited to get the VR version of Eyes of the Night into the hands of our players, because honestly it just feels like this is the way the game should be played. It's hard to compare with the immersion that VR brings and the control that it offers (for example, your right controller is now your flashlight to aim and shine where you want). 

If you have an Oculus VR system and would like to help test, please join us on our [url=discord.gg/WuUDfbeu7r]Discord server[/url] where we will soon be posting information on how to help us wrap up the testing phase. 

Note: Initially, only Oculus systems will be supported, but we will evaluate compatibility with other VR hardware in the future.

notes.title: Version 1.2 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Spider themed art set (Spiders, spider eggs, health crystals)
[*] Added new forest art sets (thin deciduous, ancient ruins, abandoned graveyard, thin conifer)
[*] [u]Stealth Mode[/u]: an option for all difficulty levels that provides a very different gameplay experience. Here a few key points about Stealth Mode
[list]
[*] The enemies have hearing and vision. 
[*] Hearing is mostly a factor of movement (especially movement speed).
[*] Vision is mostly affected by whether you are crouching (which is new) and whether you are hiding in bushes (also new).
[*] You have a new stealth icon on your HUD that indicates how visible you are to the enemies. The size and color of the icon give you a clue as what's happening.
[*] Of course, if you have your light on...they will see you unless you're on the opposite side of the map, then...maybe...
[*] The enemies have a new "suspicious" state where they sense something but don't know exactly where it is, so they go looking in the general vicinity of where they last heard/saw something. It's possible to hide (in bushes, crouching and not moving) as they pass RIGHT by you...but that doesn't always work.
[*] There are no health potions in Stealth Mode. At all.
[*] You don't lose health in Stealth Mode unless you're hit by an enemy or your sprinting (sprinting costs less health than it does in other modes). 
[*] Obviously, you cannot do Stealth Mode Deathruns...they are pretty much the opposite of each other.
[*] Stealth Mode high scores are stored separately (example, Easy - Easy Stealth - Medium - Medium Stealth, etc)
[*] Picking up treasures (or smashing spider eggs!) will cause noise that could attract enemies! 
[/list]
[/list]



[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Moved enemy spawning farther from player at start of game
[*] Fixed several ambient sound issues
[*] Fixed issue with enemy detection of player in certain situations in Nightmare difficulty
[*] Fixed attack sound not playing correct variations as intended
[*] Fixed issue with foliage spawner
[*] Fixed collision issue with one of the bush models
[*] Fixed rare issue with art set selection not loading correctly from saved preferences
[*] Fixed rare save file versioning issue
[*] Fixed very rare issue with tree overspawning
[*] Fixed very rare AI issue where enemies would run in circles instead of circling around player on Nightmare difficulty
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improvements to input smoothing for low end systems
[*] Improvements to lighting on chests for low end systems
[*] Added game version to score, stats and main menu screens
[/list]

notes.title: First Content Update - Creepin' It Real
notes.content:
The first free content update for Eyes of the Night, the "Creepin' It Real" update is now live! This update adds Halloween themed art, Nightmare difficulty and includes several fixes for bugs found since release.

Patch notes for version 1.1.2: 

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Halloween themed art set
[*] Options for selecting active art sets
[*] Added graphics quality slider to options menu
[*] Added Nightmare Difficulty (and Nightmare Deathrun)
[/list]


[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with potions not being removed at the end of a game
[*] Fixed issue with enemies sometimes spawning too close to player
[*] Fixed game balance issue with medium difficulty
[*] Fixed issue with glowing eyes not glowing on some video cards
[*] Fixed rare issue with treasure pick up counting twice
[*] Fixed very rare issue where game would end when player still had health
[/list]


[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved terrain lighting effects (on highest two graphics quality settings)
[*] Tweaks made to post processing effects
[*] Adjusted ambient sound effects
[/list]

Our next free content update is planned for mid-November, which will add another art set and add "Stealth Mode"

notes.title: Eyes of the Night - Creepin' It Real update
notes.content:
Eyes of the Night releases today, but we have plans to continue to provide ongoing support through free updates in the coming months! Our first update, the [i]Creepin' It Real[/i] update, will be released on October 13, 2021. 

This update will include:

- A Halloween themed art set, including ghosts (in place of wolves), pumpkin treasures, bubbling cauldron potions, and more! 
- Nightmare difficulty: Nightmare will introduce a different style of play...you will lose less health over time, but additional wolves (or ghosts with the Halloween art set) will spawn in during the night and the wolves do A LOT more damage, they are faster and they are smarter. 
- Nightmare Deathrun: Using the Nightmare difficulty, the Nightmare Deathrun provides a fresh take on the Deathrun mode! 

Here is our roadmap of updates coming over the next few months! We'll also be listening and communicating with our community to gather feedback from you to determine how we can continue to make Eyes of the Night a game that is enjoyable, different and challenging! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41214290/347d781b5de240b4981150461ff3758bccfbbf86.png[/img]

Thank you to all of you who are a part of Eyes of the Night!

notes.title: Release Day
notes.content:
Eyes of the Night is now available for purchase! 

We are excited to get Eyes of the Night into your hands. And we have more content coming...we are currently testing our first FREE content update, coming October 13! We encourage you to jump into the Community Hub and share your high scores with us as screenshots or use the Discussion board to brag about your best runs. 

And be sure to join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/WuUDfbeu7r]Discord server[/url] for information about what's coming next from Lama glama Game Company.

Thanks for joining us on this little project and I hope you enjoy it! 

- Tom
Alpha Llama
Lama glama Game Company
